profile.headline: AI Software Engineer at Adobe | Latina in Tech
profile.summary:
I am a Latinx, first-generation immigrant, and full-stack software engineer with a background in UX and Cognitive Science. My path in the tech field was sparked after interning in a startup as a UX Associate. I was really drawn into the field because it allowed me to intertwine my knowledge in cognitive science to think and create user friendly experiences. It was through this experience that I found my true passion in software engineering after collaborating with the engineering team to implement my designs. My background as a UX designer and researcher has provided me with the necessary skills to design through the lens of a user. My goal and purpose as a software engineer is to draw from my experiences to create human-centric solutions for all.

I enjoy nerding out on the intersection between computer science, cognitive psychology, and education. I welcome any messages with articles or questions to poke at this interest. 

Technical Skills:
• Language and Frameworks: Javascript, Python, HTML, CSS, MATLAB, React, Node.js, Django, Express
• Management and Deployment: Github, Git, Heroku
• Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB
• Methodologies: Object-Oriented Programming, Agile Development/Scrum, Responsive Design, Wireframing, User stories, UX Methodologies 
• Spoke/Written Languages: English, Spanish

positions.title: Software Engineer Apprentice | Adobe Digital Academy
Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Enhanced the overall experience of the page by building an interactive progress pie-chart using React’s Recharts Library to incorporate on the website. 
• Collaborated with design members to iterate on the brand styling through feedback sessions.
• Translated existing curricula code to different programming languages, such as MATLAB and Python, and collaborated with a senior engineer to commit an updated workshop for students.

positions.title: Civic Engagement Fellow
positions.description:
Support the organization's grassroots fundraising and campaign efforts. Organize canvassing initiatives to educate voters on measures important to social justice issues.

Lead a team of 5 to manage the development and implementation of civic and voter engagement.

Head of the alumni network coordinating and fundraising. Oversee the administration of scholarship to college bound high school seniors.

positions.title: Youth Organizer
positions.description:
Employ recruitment and retention strategies for a base of students at a high school chapter by leading the political education and leadership development component for the region. 

Wrote and facilitated political education curriculum and trainings for students of immigrant, socioeconomically disadvantaged backgrounds.

positions.title: UX Designer and Researcher
positions.description:
• Improved user engagement in museum's collections by conducting generative user research and iterating wireframes for a mobile application. 
• Conducted in-person survey interviews and online surveys to understand the needs and wants of both stakeholders and museum visitors.
• Acted as a liaison for museum stakeholders by communicating design iterations to reflect the brand and goals of the museum. 
• Collaborated with design team to develop a prototype that was ultimately pushed for mobile application implementation.

positions.title: UI/UX Associate
positions.description:
• Improved the user interface (UI) of tutoring platform by analyzing usability pain points that lowered user conversion rates through Google Analytics and used findings to guide UX designs. 
• Created usability metric reports used by business and engineering team to improve webpage productivity.
• Communicated design rationale to development team and collaborated with engineering team to apply UI changes in HTML and CSS. 
• Took ownership of blog page redesign which resulted in an increase in user conversion rates by 16%.

positions.title: Reservationist
positions.description: Meet with UCLA student groups to reserve and organize weekly meetings and events on campus. Tasks include navigating reservation system, customer service, check emails, and answer calls.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
Designed and conducted cognitive psychology studies relating to topics of memory and attention.

• Conducted literature reviews to inform the experimental design.
• Ran human subjects through experimental procedures in a laboratory setting.
• Managed the data collection and distribution of various research questionnaires.
• Analyzed and organized experimental data in Microsoft Excel and SPSS.
• Cultivated proficiency at statistical analysis and interpretation.
• Presented and synthesized results through research papers and powerpoint presentations to students and staff.

positions.title: Student Ambassador
positions.description: Supported current and prospective students in navigating college in fields such as financial aid, enrollment, and transferring to four-year university. Facilitated campus tours and workshops. Provided office assistance — making calls, inputing data, planned and organized campus events.

positions.title: Youth Organizer
positions.description:
-Lead campaigns in the East Side Union High School District around issues of social justice, college readiness, and racial equity.
-Organized events to support our youth-led local and statewide campaigns. Examples include advocacy with school board members, rallies, fundraising events, etc.. 
-Created and facilitated leadership development workshops including topics of campaign development, public speaking, messaging, fundraising, conducting community surveys, etc. 
-Recruited and helped develop high schools students to lead our local and statewide campaigns around school and access issues.
